name: Knockout Dressing

features.text: A ready-to-use water-based dressing for rubber, vinyl and plastic.
The outstanding floral fragrance is pleasing for the user and also aids in deodorization of vehicle interiors.
This product is the industry standard for universal, water- based dressing.

description: Knockout Dressing™ is a universal, water-based, silicone-protectant. This product is bright white in color and has a clean, floral aroma. Knockout Dressing™ protects, beautifies and restores tires, vinyl, rubber and leather.
application: Spray evenly on a clean, dry tire. Do not wipe. Allow to dry thoroughly until dressing turns from white, milky look to a black shiny surface. On other surfaces, apply dressing with a clean cloth. Allow to dry and wipe off excess. Warning: As a tire dressing, excess product should be wiped from surface to prevent “sling,” which can stain some painted-plastic surfaces.
review: Has a Performance Ratings section: Gloss - 7 Durability - 3
